readings: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the signals table, compute its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Take the overall average to be the mean of these per-telescope averages, so each telescope counts once. Keep only the telescopes whose average is above that overall average. For each one, show the telescope reference, its average modulation index, how far it is above the overall average (its average minus the overall average), and its average divided by the mean of the averages of just these above-average telescopes. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest and return the top 10, without rounding.
queries:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
    SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY telescref
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
    FROM telescope_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg
    FROM telescope_averages AS t
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
    telescref,
    avg_modindex,
    avg_modindex - overall_avg AS amount_above_overall_avg,
    avg_modindex / (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM above_average) AS ratio
FROM above_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
